name: Second
oneLiner: 个人上下文层：在设备上持续构建一个属于你的「个人模型」（偏好、关系、目标和数字活动），按你的授权提供给 GrokBot、Codex 等 Agent 使用
oneLinerEn: A personal context layer that continuously builds a model of you on your device (preferences, relationships, goals and digital activity) and serves it to the agents you choose, such as GrokBot or Codex.
